results.title: Munich picked for Germany's bid to host the Summer Olympics in 2036, 2040 or 2044
results.description: Munich will bid to bring the Olympics back to Germany for the first time in more than 60 years after seeing off a rival bid from Cologne to become the focus of the country's push to host a Summer Games.

results.description: The Minister of Labour, Employment and Job Creation, Emmanuel Kwadwo Agyekum, has pledged to work with the National Labour Commission (NLC) to strengthen its operations and ensure that labour disputes are resolved fairly and, as much as possible, without recourse to the courts.
